title: Dynamic Climbing
texts: Practice fluid movements by climbing with momentum

The goal of this workout is to explore how momentum can be used when moving between holds instead of climbing statically.

After completing a light movement warm-up of your choosing, such as yoga or stretching, find a wall angled between vertical to 20 degrees overhanging with problems that are very easy for you to complete (e.g., warm-up climbs).  Begin each movement using your arms and legs to generate a gentle swing that propels you to the next hold.  You should be able to move from hold to hold without stopping.  Rest for 2 minutes before repeating the same problem 2 additional times.

After completing the first boulder, rest for 2-3 minutes before completing the drill on two additional boulders.  You will climb a total of 3 different boulders, 1 time each, for 3 problems in total.
